$comment: Resources panel for the side column of the zone attestation page (a second web part: <div data-psz-resources data-config=".../ps-zone-attestation.resources.json">). Item types: feature (the large job aid card), link (a compact document link), text (a small heading + one paragraph), contact (name + email). An empty url shows the item unlinked, so placeholders still show; set it to an http(s) or server-relative address to make it a link. Icons: a path under design/ or a sprite name (document, document-pdf, shield, info...). Every text can be an { en, fr } pair. Everything below is placeholder text, to be replaced.
